summary: Homing projectile tracking its target's live position, safe if the target dies mid-flight.
overview: Tracks where the target IS, not where it was at launch, and damages on arrival. If the target is destroyed in flight — killed by another tower first — it self-destructs harmlessly instead of erroring on a stale reference. That is the difference between it and the straight-line combat projectile.
useCases: Tower shots that should follow a moving enemy.
Any projectile in a scene where targets die frequently.

params.tuning: How close counts as arrival. Too small and a fast projectile can overshoot between frames and orbit its target.

gotchas.title: Homing means it cannot be dodged
gotchas.body: It follows the target until arrival. An enemy that should be able to escape needs a different projectile.
